column1: # U9GL per-entry fingerprints of the files fan patches edit. Built by tools/dev/entry_fingerprints.py
# on 2026-11-26; every source file matched its u9-game-data.tsv row first.
# Rows are folder, file, build, unit, count, base64 of count 4-byte hashes (the first 4 bytes of each
# unit's SHA-256; 0 for an unused FLX slot). Units: entry = an FLX slot; record = a 316-byte NPC
# record of NPC.FLX's slot 0; health = that record's three health words (0x34..0x39).
